data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's 2018 report indicates no explicit gross prior year development figure. The gross claims development triangle is significantly impacted by a Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) agreement in 2018, which transferred Pioneer business liabilities for underwriting years 2014-2017 to Syndicate 1980, making the triangle unreliable for calculating pure prior year development. Narrative text suggests "better loss experience" and a decrease in the claims ratio from 79% in 2017 to 60% in 2018, generally pointing to favourable development. However, the report also mentions "a number of natural catastrophes and market losses" in the second half of 2018, and prior year large losses from Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, and Maria in 2017. Other factors influencing claims estimates include changes in Syndicate processes, the legal environment, inflation, mix of business, large losses, industry benchmarks, market factors, economic conditions, and foreign exchange movements.
